subject: general
question: Which of the following options have the correct sequence of the Mughal emperors chronologically?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Humayun, Akbar, Jehangir, Shah Jahan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sequence of the Mughal emperors chronologically are as follows:
 
• **Babur → Humayun → Akbar → Jahangir → Shah-Jahan → Aurangzeb** → Bahadur Shah → Jahandar Shah → Farrukhsiyar Muhammad Shah → Ahmad Shah Bahadur → Alamgir II → Shah Alam II → Akbar Shah II → Bahadur Shah II.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **Shortcut Trick__** Trick To Remember Mughal Rulers: **BHAJI SABJI FOR MAAM-SAAB**

 
• **BHAJI**

 
 
• B – Babur
 
• H – Humayun
 
• A – Akbar
 
• JI – Jahangir
 
 
 
• **SABJI**
 
 
• S – Shah Jahan
 
• A – Aurangzeb
 
• B – Bahadur Shah
 
• JI – Jahandar Shah
 
 
 
• **FOR**
 
 
• FOR – Faruque Sirar
 
 
 
• **MAAM**
 
 
• M – Muhammad Shah
 
• A – Ahmad Shah
 
• AM – Alamgir
 
 
 
• **SAAB**
 
 
• SA – Shah Alam
 
• A – Akbar Shah
 
• B – Bahadur Shah Jafar
